top_signals.title: Ukraine confirms it sank Russian corvette in Libyan port
top_signals.summary: Ukraine was behind the explosive sinking of the Russian corvette Merkury in the Libyan port of Benghazi over the weekend, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, and the country’s military released accompanying videos.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Margin Calls Soared 200-Fold in Taiwan as Traders Fled AI Bets
top_signals.summary: Julia Lee, a stockbroker in Taiwan, spent so much time making margin calls last week that she decided to add a human touch. She sent empathetic messages to suffering traders, saying she was there to help them ride out the storm.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Treasury yields jump as stock futures rebound, investors await New York Fed President Williams speech
top_signals.summary: U.S. Treasury yields rose Monday, partially unwinding price action seen at the end of last week, as stock futures pointed to a strong rebound on Wall Street.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Treasuries Decline as Haven Demand Wanes on Stock Market Gains
top_signals.summary: US Treasuries edged lower as investors unwound haven buying following signs that global stock markets may be stabilizing.
